title: nEBULA Complete Verilog Response
description: One complete candidate design. Return the entire Verilog content of every SourceBundle source file, including unchanged files; no patches, line ranges, placeholders, or suggested edits.

chosen_pattern_id.description: Optimization pattern used to guide the rewrite. Exploratory rewrites may use null.

target_unit_id.description: Optional optimization-unit identifier supplied by build_request.py.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of the implemented complete-source optimization.

predicted_wns_gain_ns.description: Model-estimated WNS improvement in nanoseconds. This is advisory only and is never trusted for acceptance.

predicted_area_change_pct.description: Optional model-estimated area percentage change. Negative means smaller.

predicted_power_change_pct.description: Optional model-estimated power percentage change. Negative means lower.

source_files.description: Every SourceBundle file exactly once, with its complete candidate source text.

verilog.description: Complete compilable Verilog file, including all modules, declarations, assignments and always blocks. No omissions or Markdown fences.

$comment: v3: complete source files; exact bundle identity, structural checks, frozen lines, formal and PPA gates remain enforced.
